items.summary: Disposition: blocked for public launch and monetization changes. Woot documentation proves API access but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal data; current public terms point against the proposed use. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates also remain incomplete. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. Human counsel is required before any rights outreach, public beta, affiliate use, advertising, or data-use exception. Ordinary reversible fleet growth may continue only within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Tracking remains active with 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Source-rights evidence is captured and establishes a blocking conflict; data-flow and consent evidence are partial; vendor/log evidence remains incomplete. Next evidence actions are: attach an authoritative Woot permission or agreement, produce the read-only alert data-flow and retention table, capture deployed consent and GA4 settings, and inventory logs/vendors/incident procedures. Do not repeat generic owner requests or change the private gate.
